correctness.rationale: For any positive weights, the first-coordinate Krylov flag is exactly the initial coordinate flag; the residual complement satisfies v_j=w_j v_{j+1} and yields reciprocal prefix products by projection. Termwise extrema prove the simultaneous rearrangement law. Exact geometric sums give the two-block formula; B(reversal)=J B(transpose) J preserves singular values. The self-contained checker passes 39018 exact-rational assertions; none is treated as a proof of the infinite family.

value.rationale: A natural sparse triangular factor model with a fixed source shows, through complete sharp optimization over its positive edge-multiset and an explicit reversed pair, that full singular spectrum and eigenvalues can be identical while near-terminal GMRES residuals differ by asymptotically sqrt(5/8)*2^m. It turns vague nonnormal sensitivity into a quantitative, exactly reproducible algorithmic boundary; the restriction to a chain and one start is essential and explicitly stated.
